FN-MSZ541W-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 120
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator J.T. 'Jabo' Waggoner
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/29/2025
Senate Bill 120 as introduced would exempt the Alabama Eye Bank from paying state, county,
and municipal sales and use taxes, which would decrease receipts to the following funds by the
estimated annual amounts beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 and ending in Fiscal Year 2030, based
on information provided by the entity:
Education Trust Fund ($63,620)
County Funds ($31,810)
Municipal Funds ($63,620)
Total ($159,050)
Page 1
